rules.summary: Use exactly one graph root; session and state_machine are not accepted by Resource Gateway authoring.
Give the graph a stable identifier followed by a braced member block.
Declare each operator node as node name : operatorRef and use only references returned by this snapshot.
Place input, output, dependency, timeout and retry declarations inside the node body.
Assign each named input from ctx or an upstream node output inside an input block.
Use only input and output port names returned in the selected operator contracts.
Declare each output field as name = expression; optional type annotations precede the equals sign.
Name every decision input and declare a structured result type.
For hit=unique, keep rules non-overlapping and include an otherwise rule when inputs are not exhaustive.
Treat the effect and bindingState in the operator contract as authoritative; preview does not prove live execution readiness.

examples.intent: Return a value from the request context without external calls
Read one governed resource and shape its response
Evaluate an explicit rule matrix with a safe fallback
